thread.title: U.S. stocks slightly higher after Fed statement - MarketWatch

author: Ryan Vlastelica
title: U.S. stocks slightly higher after Fed statement - MarketWatch
text:
Published: May 2, 2018 2:03 p.m. ET Share Ryan Vlastelica Markets reporter
U.S. stocks inched higher on Wednesday, after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged as had been widely expected. The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.76% rose 0.1% to 24,126. The S&P 500 SPX, -0.74% rose less than 0.1% to 2,655, but it moved into positive territory for the day. The Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, -0.36% rose 0.2% to 7,148. In its statement, the Fed took note of rising prices and said it now expects inflation to "run near" its 2% target "over the medium term." Both the Dow and the S&P had been in modestly lower territory before the Fed's statement was released, while the Nasdaq had been slightly higher, supported by strong results at Apple Inc. AAPL, +4.64%
